evidence.quote: For example, if your usage is 50% on AWS (Amazon Web Services), 30% on Google Cloud, and 20% on Microsoft Azure, then Atlas splits your monthly support cost across those providers in the same ratio.
Atlas distributes support charges proportionally across the cloud providers that host your usage. The Details section lists a separate support line item for each cloud provider you use.

statements.statement: Atlas apportions support charges by cloud usage and lists separate provider support rows.
Its example divides support 50% to AWS, 30% to Google Cloud, and 20% to Microsoft Azure.
statements.note: Example appears on the invoice-breakdown page.

edits.rationale: The Atlas invoice-breakdown page states that support charges are distributed proportionally across cloud providers, with a separate support line item per provider. It gives the 50% AWS, 30% Google Cloud, 20% Azure example. The additional-services page confirms the proportional distribution and per-provider rows.

evidence.quote: If you don't have usage on a cloud provider, no support line item appears for that provider.
Support usage that isn't associated with a cloud provider appears under Other Atlas Usage.

statements.statement: A provider without usage has no support row.

edits.rationale: The invoice-breakdown page says no support line item appears for a provider without usage. Both it and the additional-services page say support usage not associated with a cloud provider appears under Other Atlas Usage.
